title: xDrip confuses G5 with a G6 and performs a preemptive restart on day 9 as well as on day 6
symptom: In native mode with a Dexcom G5, xDrip (releases February 3 and February 11, 2021) logs that calibrations are rejected even though the G5 transmitter accepted them; the calibration graph/table are unavailable/empty and only "Initial calibration" remains in the top-left menu. The title also reports that xDrip performs a preemptive restart on day 9 as well as on day 6.
cause: The thread states that xDrip confuses the Dexcom G5 with a G6 (specifically a Firefly G6, which does not send raw data) and treats it accordingly; this is attributed to a regression in the February 3–11, 2021 xDrip releases, though no deeper root cause is identified in the thread.
fix: Navid200's stated solution/workaround is to go back to the January 29, 2021 xDrip release; trying the February 17, 2021 nightly was also suggested and initially seemed to resolve the issue. Later reports indicate day-6/day-9 restart behavior varied by version and no permanent code fix is described in the thread.
evidence_quote: The only solution I am aware of, until a developer addresses this, is to go back to the release of January 29, 2021.
